notes.title: Mercator 0.4.2
notes.content:
Salvete mercatores,

Mercator 0.4.2 is released. See the changelog below:

[list]
[*] Added Simplified Chinese localization.
[*] Removed the negotiation rejection timer. Now your deals are only rejected when it's the customer's turn to adjust terms.
[*] Added an info blurb about how you cannot place a workstation in a shop with no valid placement tiles, and how you'd need a new shop or to replace the existing workstation.
[*] Adjusted the switch merchant button blurb to indicate you can press 'TAB' to switch merchants.
[*] Added indications that there are idle workers/customers in shops controlled by a given merchant right above the corresponding switch merchant button.
[*] Added customer/people portraits.
[*] Adjusted map sprite.
[*] Adjusted merchant animations.
[*] Added music to the intro.
[/list]
Note: Mercator will be presented during the June Steam Next Fest. Please let me know of any issues you encounter while playing the game!
